messages:
incbot: [09:12] INCIDENT: Paging integration failure detected. Pagerflow -> PagerDuty deliveries failing with 502/504. Severity: P2. Initiating investigation. :rotating_light:

sahil: any idea whether the oncall actually got pages? saw a spike in alerts but no PD incidents in the channel.

maya: checking PD webhook logs now — seeing upstream 502s from pagerflow. grabbing snippets.

maya: logs:
```
POST /webhook/pd HTTP/1.1 502
{"error":"upstream connect error: connection refused"}
Host: pagerflow-internal
```:confused:

alex: Pagerflow status page shows no global outage. Could be our signing or timeout behavior in incident-bot.

maya: repro with curl from prod NAT: 
```
curl -i -X POST https://pagerflow-internal/api/webhook -H "X-Service: incident-bot" -d '{"event":"test"}'
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
< HTTP/1.1 502 from upstream (connect timeout)
```

maya: I'm switching incident-bot to a fallback route (pagerbridge) to restore paging while we dig into pagerflow connectivity. Manual paging ready if needed. @oncall-rotation please stand by.

oncall-rotation: I didn't get the automated page. starting manual escalation via PD UI for the active alerts.

sahil: manual broadcast started for affected services. quick customer check: cust-omega and cust-gamma had alerts that did NOT result in pages for ~25m. cataloging customers and contacts.

alex: deploying a small timeout/tls tweak to incident-bot to see if that reduces the 502s. also increasing retry backoff to avoid quick suppression.

deploy-bot: deploy triggered: incident-bot v1.42.7 -> v1.42.8 (canary -> prod).

deploy-bot: deploy complete: success. canary ok, rolling to all nodes.

maya: after route flip and deploy, PD webhook deliveries are returning 200s again. pagerflow retry queue drained. monitoring for 15m.

sahil: paging backlog cleared. no missed pages for last 20m. estimated impact: delayed oncall notifications for a subset of Pagerflow flows, potential delayed response for customers listed. we've notified cust-omega by email.

alex: follow-ups (created tickets):
- SYNTH-124: add synthetic PD-delivery heartbeat and alert on N failed deliveries > 3
- INFRA-547: increase webhook retry attempts and expose per-route delivery metrics
- SEC-312: validate TLS ciphers between incident-bot and Pagerflow (hotfix applied)

maya: assigning postmortem owner: maya. timeline: 72 hours for draft, include timeline, root cause, and mitigation.

maya: handing monitoring to next oncall @liz. I'll attach logs and the retry/route config in the postmortem. :white_check_mark:

liz: ACK. I'll keep an eye overnight and add any alerts to the ticket if they reappear. please add me to the postmortem doc.

sahil: brief summary for ops: paging automation degraded due to upstream connection failures from pagerflow; incident-bot route fallback + small TLS/timeout change restored deliveries; manual paging used during remediation.

incbot: INCIDENT: status -> mitigated. further updates in postmortem.
